entries.name: CALENDLY_ACCESS_TOKEN
entries.description: A Calendly personal access token with only the users:read and scheduled_events:read scopes, for the scheduled events and invitees the connector reads. Made by an owner or admin it reads the whole organization's appointments; made by anyone else, only their own.
howToGet: Sign in to Calendly as an owner or admin of the organization, so every team member's appointments are read, and open Integrations & apps > API and webhooks.
Choose Get a token now (or Generate new token), name it KaratOS, and pick only the Users read and Scheduled events read scopes. Leave every write scope, and webhooks, unticked.
Copy the token straight into the host's secret store. Calendly shows it once. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
